primary_endpoint: Histological improvement of at least 2 points in NAS on liver biopsy after 1 year.
efficacy_outcome: Reported NAS score change: −1.6 with pentoxifylline versus −0.1 with placebo; no statistical comparison reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/26 with pentoxifylline and 0/29 with placebo; deaths not reported.
